_note: Item icons rendered in Blender as ball-and-stick molecules. Scope: molecules built only from H, C, N, O. 'pubchem' is the compound name queried for its 3D conformer; 'formula' is checked against the download. Large molecules set hide_h with thicker atoms/bonds so they survive the 18-28 px UI sizes.

liquid_hydrogen._why: PubChem has no 3D conformer for H2, so the structure is inline: bond length 0.741 Angstrom.

polymer_precursor._why: Archetypal monomer; the recipe cracks octane over a catalyst.

amino_acid._why: The recipe's inputs are exactly glycine: 2C 5H 1N 2O.

fatty_acid._why: The recipe implies a C16 chain, but 16 carbons is a hairline at icon size; C8 keeps the chain and acid head readable.
